description: Use when an agent is about to pay an unknown address. Quick facts about a payTo wallet on Base/Ethereum: contract or EOA, nonce, ETH/USDC balance, recent USDC flow, optional domain declaration. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base).

address.description: payTo address to check (0x + 40 hex chars) or ENS/Basename (vitalik.eth, name.base.eth)

domain.description: optional seller domain, e.g. api.example.com: we GET its /.well-known/paycheck.json and /.well-known/x402.json (3 s timeout, public hosts only) and report whether the address is declared there

name: payto_check
title: Pay-to check: facts about an unknown payTo wallet before an agent pays it (Base or Ethereum)
